asr.full_text: Hello. Hello and welcome to another update video on BNB. So the BNB chart is currently in a correction here. We're dealing with a pullback currently. And I said to you already a few weeks ago that this chart would still look best with another low. We might see another low in the 5th wave, to the downside of circle wave C. A couple of reasons for that, I mean, first of all, we need to establish that we are still in a correction here, and we might see that one more Lowe here, but the main reason that I highlighted here is that, you know, if we have from this, the top in October, an initial impulse down which we had in the A wave here, then, ok, maybe not an impulse, maybe more like a diagonal or even an ABC, to be honest, but that doesn't matter so much. A waves are very often three wave movements. And then we had a B wave. Well, based on that we can define the target for the C wave, in this case, C wave to the downside, and that takes us to the 100% extension, $559. That's an ideal target and we're not there. We didn't arrive there. Okay, we don't have to. No. It's not a must. But, then at least we should have 5 waves down, because a c-wave should be 5 waves. I mean, there are exceptions for everything, and the market can choose to take the less probable pathway, but I'm typically trying to align my expectations with the most probable pathway. Which is AA down, BWA up, CWA down. And we seem to be in this C wave to the downside. And the C wave should be 12345 actually, this wave four reached ideal targets for a fourth wave because what we normally expect in a fourth wave is a corrective bounce into a standard resistance zone. In this case 684 to 722. This is our standard resistance area. Micro resistance and especially the 38.2 retracement is, normally, an ideal target for a fourth wave. So we got there and if the price now accelerates a little further to the downside, this might indeed be our fifth wave to the downside that I'm labeling 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. So we might go a little bit lower. I'm not quite sure about the microstructure here. I mean, it's an altcoin, you know, anything kind of on the smaller time frames could lead to a lot of distortions, you know, but it does look, hold on, it does look a little bit as if we are in this fifth wave to the downside. Frozen here, there you go. Again I would not rely on the microstructure here but I am watching the 559 level as next key support level and possible target. If we can't hold there we cannot hold support there then 5.29 will be the next key level to watch. And only a five wave advance that actually takes the price above $684, the last swing high from the 16th of March would lead to a reversal to the upside. Now, this would be our first signal that we formed a low. That's the update on BNB. If you did, please hit the like button. Leave a comment and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates, I recommend that you check out our ex-channel for additional updates, charts, news, and much more. Thanks so much. Bye-bye.
